Case Study · Fintech · Credit & Risk

Fintech Product Suite: request every data source in one flow.

Place Request Flow unifies MCA, ITR, GST, Bank Statement and Credit Bureau retrieval — previously six separate products — into a single request an underwriter can start, track and complete without leaving Databook.

RoleUI UX Designer
CompanyAccumn — A Yubi Company
DomainFintech · Credit & Risk
ScopeWorkflow design, design system
01 — The challenge

Every financial data source lived in its own silo.

Databook already offered MCA, ITR, GST, Bank Statement, Credit Bureau and Financial Statement data — but each was requested through its own flow, with its own copy of the applicant's details.

Fragmentation

Every product lived alone

Lenders needed FSA, BSA, Credit Bureau and MCA data from Databook, but each sat behind its own flow — request one, then start over for the next.

Repetition

The same details, retyped

Basic info, PAN and contact details had to be re-entered for every data source, multiplying the chance a typo would block a request.

Visibility

No single view of what was sent

Once a request went out, tracking its status — or resuming a stalled one — meant digging through separate logs per product.

02 — Approach

Three decisions that shaped the flow.

01

One request, many sources

A single "New Request" wizard lets the lender select any combination of MCA Data, ITR-Consent, GST-Consent, Bank Statements, Credit Bureau and Financial Statements up front, with "Select All" for the common case.

02

Applicant info entered once

PAN, name, contact and address are captured a single time in Basic Info and carried through every later step and every data source selected — no re-typing per product.

03

A preview before it goes out, a history after

A Final Request Submission screen recaps every source's status and lets the team add related parties before submitting; Request History then tracks every past request's status, sources and completion date in one searchable table.

03 — Inside the product

A walk through the flow.

Six screens covering the full arc — from finding a company to reviewing what came back.

Module 01

Search Company

Search resolves by company name or PAN and drops straight into the entity's workspace, where recent searches and placed requests stay one click away.

Module 02

Place Request

The entity's Profile page carries a persistent "Place Request" action, so starting a new data pull never requires hunting through a menu.

Module 03

Source Selection

Every data source — MCA, ITR, GST, Bank Statements, Credit Bureau, FSA — appears as a single card with its own scope note, pre-checked for the common case and toggleable per request.

Module 04

New Request Flow

An 8-step wizard opens with Basic Info — applicant PAN, name, contact and address — captured once and reused by every subsequent step.

Module 05

Preview

Before submission, Final Request Submission recaps every source's status at a glance and surfaces auto-fetched related parties for review — nothing goes out unseen.

Module 06

Request History

Every request ever placed — across every product — lands in one searchable table with status, sources and completion date, replacing per-product logs with a single view.

04 — Outcome

What the unified flow delivers.

6standalone data sources unified into one request flow
1applicant profile captured once and reused across every source
8step wizard guiding a request from Basic Info to Preview
1searchable history replacing per-product request logs

Screens shown are from the Place Request feature built on Databook at Accumn — A Yubi Company. Company name, person name, PAN, CIN and internal requester emails have been blurred for data privacy.
